requirements: R1: The application's health check must successfully resolve the backend service hostname
R2: The backup service must start successfully with executable permissions for its backup script

slices.title: Patch runtime environment network and permission errors
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime fixes for this epic, I want to correct network resolution and script permissions, so that the deployment starts successfully without failing health checks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean deployment environment
When the deployment stack is launched
Then the health check resolves the backend service correctly
And the backup service executes its scheduled script without permission denied errors
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease runtime launch errors from 2 to 0
